text:
Priya Patel: Quick sync — we need to finalize roles/policies and legal artifacts for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. AWS wants a Publisher role & IAM contact by Fri. Who's owning the Seller Central admin creation?

Alex Kim: I can take AWS Seller Central admin. Need the email to use and the SC account ID. Also can someone confirm SKU mapping across clouds (are we using cloud-specific SKUs or one canonical SKU per offering)?

Tess Nguyen: For packaging, product bundles differ per cloud — recommend SKU pattern: `redwood-inference-<tier>-<region>-<cloud>` so we can map pricing and telemetry easily.

Liam O'Connor: FYI, Azure requires marketplace offer ID + notarized logo asset and a contact for legal. Is marketing preparing the logos? @Tess

Marketplace Legal: Required artifacts checklist (short): 1) MSA copy, 2) Trademark clearance for logo, 3) Data Processing Addendum (DPA), 4) SOC2 summary + cert, 5) Contact email for billing/legal. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/artifacts

Priya Patel: I'm drafting a one-pager for legal. Also need the exact legal entity name for contracts per cloud — should we standardize on `Redwood Inference, Inc.` across AWS/GCP/Azure?

Alex Kim: Use `Redwood Inference, Inc.` per finance. I'll create Seller Central admin with `marketplace-admin@redwood.ai` and will post the SC account ID here when it's ready.

Partner Ops Bot: :spiral_calendar: Reminder — marketplace onboarding form due 2026-04-10. Fill here: https://forms.gle/marketplace-onboard (auto-reminder set).

Tess Nguyen: Packaging note for GCP: include two SKUs — `BYOL` and `Redwood-managed`. Example manifest snippet we can reuse for all clouds:
```
{
  "sku": "RWI-MANAGED-GCP-1",
  "tier": "pro",
  "entitlement": "monthly",
  "cloud": "gcp"
}
```

Liam O'Connor: I'll coordinate with marketing on logos + the offer copy. Also will reach out to Azure marketplace rep re: offer ID mapping. Can Marketplace Legal assign PR-review for copy and DPA? @Marketplace Legal

Marketplace Legal: Assigning initial review to Priya, copying counsel (internal). We'll need the draft MSA + sample customer data flow diagram before formal sign-off.

Priya Patel: Great — I'll upload the MSA draft and flow diagram to the confluence page and tag reviewers. Tentative timeline: AWS by Fri, Azure by next Wed, GCP by EOM. Everyone okay with those targets? :calendar:

Alex Kim: Timeline works for me. I'll post Seller Central ID + IAM contact once created.

Priya Patel: Thanks team :thumbsup: If anything slips, let's escalate in #release-war-room.
